extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Addition and subtraction up to 4 digits — start from ones place, move left. Without regrouping: 3456 + 1232 = 4688 (no carry). With regrouping: 2345 + 1678 = 4023 (carry from ones to tens to hundreds to thousands). Subtraction with borrowing: 5000 - 2347 = 2653 (borrow from thousands to hundreds to tens to ones). (2) Multiplication tables up to 10 — know all tables from 2 to 10. 7x8=56, 9x6=54, 8x8=64, 7x9=63, 6x8=48, 9x9=81. (3) Two and three digit multiplication — standard algorithm: 234 x 3 = 702 (multiply 3 by each digit, carry over). Lattice method: draw a grid, multiply digits in cells, add along diagonals. (4) Single digit division — 48/6=8, 72/8=9, 56/7=8. Division is sharing equally. (5) Four operations in real life — addition: combining totals. subtraction: finding what is left or difference. multiplication: equal groups. division: sharing equally. Example: 8 boxes of 12 pens, sell 45, how many left? 8x12=96, 96-45=51. (6) Word problems — read the problem, identify quantities, choose the operation, solve with correct units (rupees, metres, kilograms, litres). (7) Estimation — round to nearest ten or hundred, then calculate mentally. 48 rounds to 50, 73 rounds to 70, estimated sum = 120. Exact sum = 121, close to estimate. Rounding rule: 0-4 round down, 5-9 round up. Misconceptions: 'addition always goes left to right' (always start from the ONES place on the RIGHT and move left), 'borrowing changes the answer' (borrowing is just exchanging — the value stays the same, we just regroup), 'multiplication is the same as addition' (multiplication is repeated addition — 6x8 means 8 added 6 times, not 6+8), 'estimation is guessing randomly' (estimation uses rounding rules — it is a calculated approximation, not a random guess), 'division makes numbers bigger' (division SPLITS a number into equal parts, so the answer is smaller than the original number, except when dividing by 1). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function OperationsGame), NOT export default. Export interface OperationsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
